why: Stale and overtaken: published November 10 at 10:31 am IST (about 30 hours ago), it reports only the toss and says 'start of play and any score were not available'; its 'What happens next' section previews a match that has long since finished, so the reader is not told who won or whether India sealed the series. The English says the toss was pushed back 'by well over an hour' but the Hindi says 'more than one and a half hours' (डेढ़ घंटे से ज़्यादा), so the twins do not match.
